tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Pale sky. Tinted section bands, selected rows, hover wash on ghost buttons, info chip ground. `ink-900` and `sky-700` text read on it.

tokens.name: sky-500
tokens.usage: Brand sky blue. Primary button fill, the global-model line in charts, network signal pulses, active toggle track. Text on it is always `on-sky` (4.7:1 light, 8.0:1 dark) — never white.

tokens.name: sky-600
tokens.usage: Deep sky. Brand mark colour, line icons on light grounds, selected-state outlines, the focus ring (see `focus`). Not for body text on mist (4.0:1); use `sky-700`.

tokens.name: sky-700
tokens.usage: Accent text: links, eyebrow labels, active tab text. 5.8:1 on `surface-000`, 5.3:1 on `sky-100` (light); 9:1+ on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: sky-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill — it lightens, it never darkens. `on-sky` text stays 5.7:1.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `sky-500` / `sky-hover` fills.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Slate navy — headings and body copy on every surface (`surface-000`, `surface-100`, `surface-raised`, `glass`, `sky-100`). Never pure black or pure white.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, axis labels, metadata, helper text. 5.6:1+ on light surfaces, 6.6:1+ on dark.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Cloud white / deep ocean navy. Page ground beneath the sky background.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Mist gray. Alternating section bands, table stripes, input wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid card ground where blur is unavailable or over busy charts; the flip side of security cards.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass-light card fill, always with `blur-glass` backdrop blur and a 1px `border-sky` edge. Falls back to `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Text-backing scrim behind any copy that sits on the animated sky, so AA holds at every point of the dawn → dusk cycle.

tokens.name: border-sky
tokens.usage: Pale-sky hairline: card edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, toggle chips and secondary buttons (3:1 on surfaces).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 4.2:1 on light surfaces, 8:1 on dark.

tokens.name: block-100
tokens.usage: Block / fraud tint. Ground of block pills, the BLOCKED transfer card, rejected-signal rows.

tokens.name: block-500
tokens.usage: Warm coral — block, fraud, invalid signature. Status dots, cracked-seal mark, the block zone of the policy gauge, coral chart series. Pair with a word or icon; never colour alone.

tokens.name: block-700
tokens.usage: Block text and icons on `block-100`, `surface-000` and `surface-raised` (4.7:1+ light, 6:1+ dark).

tokens.name: stepup-100
tokens.usage: Step-up tint. Ground of step-up pills and the amber “note” chip on security cards.

tokens.name: stepup-500
tokens.usage: Amber — step-up / extra verification, and stated limitations. Gauge middle zone, status dots. Too light for text or icons on light grounds (2:1): use `stepup-700`.

tokens.name: stepup-700
tokens.usage: Step-up text and icons on `stepup-100` and light surfaces (5.4:1 light).

tokens.name: allow-100
tokens.usage: Allow / safe tint. Ground of allow pills, healthy-network banners, passing-test badges.

tokens.name: allow-500
tokens.usage: Sea green — allow, safe, verified, tests passing. Status dots, gauge allow zone, valid-certificate gate.

tokens.name: allow-700
tokens.usage: Allow text and icons on `allow-100` and light surfaces (4.6:1+ light).

tokens.name: chart-sky
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — the global / federated model, drawn bold (2.5px). As a line it is under 3:1 on light surfaces, so it is always direct-labelled in `ink-900`.

tokens.name: chart-teal
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. Direct-label it; under 3:1 as a line on light surfaces.

tokens.name: chart-ocean
tokens.usage: Chart series 3; also the default colour for local-bank thin lines.

tokens.name: chart-sand
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Bars and areas only on light themes (2:1 as a thin line).

tokens.name: chart-coral
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 and fraud-class cells in confusion matrices. Never purple anywhere in charts.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the ROC chance diagonal (dashed). Axis text uses `ink-600`.

tokens.name: sky-dawn-top
tokens.usage: Dynamic sky, dawn — upper stop. Background only; text over it needs `scrim`.

tokens.name: sky-dawn-horizon
tokens.usage: Dynamic sky, dawn — soft peach horizon stop (dark: a muted pre-dawn haze, not purple).

tokens.name: sky-midday
tokens.usage: Dynamic sky, midday — clear sky stop.

tokens.name: sky-dusk
tokens.usage: Dynamic sky, dusk — deepest stop.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Blurred drifting cloud shapes on the sky background (with `blur-cloud`).

tokens.name: mesh-line
tokens.usage: Faint bank-network mesh behind network sections. Lines brighten to `sky-500` while a signal travels.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only. Scales to 38px / 44px at 375px.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: Large display numerals on metric tiles (AUC, signals/s). Always with tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, step titles in the scroll explainer.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: No raw transactions, account numbers or labels ever leave a bank.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bank A's BankBot checks the network before any money moves.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Card body, captions, the honesty note under metrics.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Pills, buttons' small size, eyebrow labels (uppercase only for eyebrows and pills).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Hashes, risk_ids, code, terminal output, exact metric values in tooltips.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Chart axis ticks, hash chips, table numerics.

spacing.note: 4px base. Side gutters are never below `space-4` (16px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills, chip padding-x, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding-y (default), list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter (minimum), compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title block and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Hash chips, inputs, tooltip, small tiles in the confusion-matrix grid.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, toggle chips, metric tiles, terminal card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards, security flip cards, chart panels, hero transfer card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, toggle knobs, bank nodes.

shadow.note: Shadows are always tinted navy/sky, never gray-black.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting glass cards, pills over the sky.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover state: card rises 4px and takes this sky-tinted shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Hero transfer card, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for `glass` cards.

tokens.name: blur-cloud
tokens.usage: filter blur for drifting cloud shapes.
